checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Face recognizably the woman from the portrait
must.why: Feminine face, similar brows, eyes and mouth; likeness moderate, somewhat generic, hair missing.

must.item: Replacement face fits inside helmet without seams or doubled features
must.why: Blends cleanly in the visor with matching lighting; slightly smooth and soft.

must.item: Original suit, helmet and stars intact
must.why: Everything outside the face looks identical to the original.

must.item: Retro poster look and vertical composition retained
must.why: Same border, grain, colours and tall format.

faults.what: Likeness is only moderate; face looks a bit generic and smoothed, with slightly plasticky skin versus the poster grain.
Curly dark hair is not shown, so the helmet interior looks like a dark cap. This was disclosed to the user.

summary: The face was swapped cleanly into the helmet with the rest of the poster unchanged and no text added; the main weakness is a moderate, slightly smoothed likeness and no curly hair.
